dedupe_keys.name: sydhavn 24 7 iot enabled smart drop off system for municipal recycling centers aau techathon 2025 prototype

description: Abir Chowdhury publishes the Sydhavn 24/7 prototype developed at an Aalborg University event in Copenhagen on 21–22 November 2025. The challenge came from the ARC-operated Sydhavn recycling centre. A freely downloadable ZIP under CC BY 4.0 contains the described prototype linking bin-access sensors, a Raspberry Pi video and QR-code system, and a web application for item inventory and rewards. Authentication is simulated, not a demonstrated live MitID connection. These materials can support prototyping of drop-off workflows or behavioural assumptions in recycling-service simulations. The deposit does not establish continuous operation at the municipal site, deployment readiness or measured environmental gains. Dependencies and code completeness remain uncertain without execution. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this prototype. Software and hardware were not installed or tested.
